vendorId.description: The operator vendor of the advice's node (never taken from the event).

ownerRef.description: The stock owner of the line; omitted for operator-owned stock.

trackingNumbers.description: The reverse labels issued for the return so far.

400.description:
The paging query is refused. Problem types: `invalid-limit` (`limit` not an integer from 1 to 500, empty or repeated),
`invalid-cursor` (the `cursor` is not a token this operation issued for this vendor, or is repeated) and
`unknown-query-parameter` (a query parameter the operation does not declare).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

404.description:
The resource does not exist (`not-found`; this includes an unknown `vendorId` on a vendor read or write), or it belongs to another vendor
(`ErrNodeNotOwnedByVendor`, problem type `node-not-owned-by-vendor`, 404 so a vendor cannot probe another vendor's nodes).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

422.description:
The request is malformed or breaks a validation rule. Problem types:
`validation-failed` (an unparsable body, an unknown or mistyped field, trailing data, a NUL character in the query or the body,
a missing or invalid `vendorId`, `createdAfter` that is not an RFC 3339 date-time, a failed field rule),
`partial-acknowledgement` (`ErrPartialAcknowledgement`) and
`ack-window-out-of-range` (`ErrAckWindowOutOfRange`).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next call.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

500.description: An unexpected error. Problem type `internal-error`; the `detail` is always the opaque text `an unexpected error occurred`.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.
